message:
feat(trades): make shared trade links actually work

The 'Link' button generated ?trade=<sideA>|<sideB> but nothing ever parsed it,
so shared links opened an empty calculator.
- parse the param on mount and load both sides, jumping to the calculator tab
- share from the site root instead of the current pathname, so a link copied
  from an item page no longer points at that item page
- persist the trade to localStorage and rehydrate on load, so a refresh keeps
  it (the existing 'clear' handler already assumed storage)
- URL parsing and rehydration live in a single effect; as two mount effects the
  storage pass ran with pre-parse state and clobbered the loaded trade
author: BSS Index Developer
